notes:
BLIND arm. Answered only from documented biography (Wikipedia; Clinton Presidential Library; NPS; Washington Post; CNN; CBS/NBC/PBS news; doctorzebra.com presidential medical history; Maraniss, 'First in His Class'; Encyclopedia of Arkansas on Whitewater; House Oversight releases). No astrological source of any kind was searched, opened, or reasoned from. Part D omitted - this exercise forbade opening any reading.

BIRTH DATA. Born 19 Aug 1946, Julia Chester Hospital, Hope, Arkansas (B5=hospital, well documented). A1/A2 = unknown: I deliberately did NOT chase a birth time, because the only widely circulated clock time for Clinton lives on astrological data sites, and consulting those would contaminate this arm. No mainstream biographical source I found states a time of birth, so 'unknown' is the honest answer for both source and precision. A3='no' on the same basis - no rectification is documented in any non-astrological source; strictly this is 'not documented' rather than a positive 'no'.

HEALTH. A4 four_plus is safe: knee surgery Mar 1997, quadruple coronary bypass Sep 2004, decortication for a partially collapsed lung Mar 2005, two coronary stents Feb 2010, five/six nights for UTI-derived sepsis Oct 2021, one night for influenza Dec 2024. A5 two_plus: tonsillectomy 1952 (age 6), sinus window 1979, quadriceps-tendon repair 1997, bypass 2004, decortication 2005, stents 2010. A6 - selected only genuinely chronic/recurring systems: head (lifelong severe allergic rhinitis, sinus surgery), ears (high-frequency hearing loss, bilateral hearing aids from 1997), heart (coronary artery disease, bypass, stents, reported defibrillator escort in later years), stomach (documented GERD; 1984 colonoscopy for rectal bleeding, no pathology), skin (acne rosacea; 1996 precancerous nasal growth; Jan 2001 basal cell carcinoma removed from back), joints (1984 left knee ligament strain, 1997 right quadriceps tendon tear). Deliberately excluded chest_lungs (the 2005 lung problem was a single post-bypass complication, not recurring) and kidney_urinary (the 2021 UTI was a single episode). A7='average' - a tonsillectomy at 6 and a childhood broken leg, nothing sickly; not 'robust' given the allergy history. A8='no' - I found no documented threat to his life before age eight; the near-drowning rescue (by Fife Symington) was in his late teens, not childhood. A9='under60' computed from actual dates: James Eldridge Cassidy 1898-1957 (58), Edith Grisham Cassidy 1901-1968 (66), William Jefferson Blythe Sr. 1884-1935 (51), Lou Birchie Ayers 1893-1946 (53) - mean about 57.

FAMILY. A10='conflicted' is a compromise and the weakest item in Part A: his biological father, William Jefferson Blythe Jr., died in a car crash on 17 May 1946, three months BEFORE his birth, so 'died_early' ('died while I was young') is literally inaccurate; the father figure he actually lived with, stepfather Roger Clinton Sr., was a gambler and alcoholic who abused the family, whom Clinton physically confronted at 14-15, and whose surname he nonetheless took by choice in 1962. Roger Sr. died of cancer in Nov 1967. A11='reversal' refers to Roger Sr., a Buick dealership part-owner who lost that position and ended as a parts manager under his brother, his fortunes wrecked by drink. A12='close' - Virginia Clinton Kelley was his lifelong champion; she died of breast cancer 6 Jan 1994, a year into his presidency. A13='close' with C11='real difficulty': he and half-brother Roger Clinton Jr. (b. 1956) were close and Bill was effectively protective/paternal, but Roger's 1984 arrest, 1985 federal cocaine-conspiracy conviction, imprisonment and the controversial Jan 2001 pardon made the sibling relationship a source of sustained public damage. B4='eldest' describes the household he grew up in; note he also had two OLDER paternal half-siblings (Leon Ritzenthaler b. 1938, Sharon Pettijohn b. 1941) whom he did not know as a child, so 'eldest' is true of lived experience, not of his father's full issue.

EDUCATION. A14='postgraduate' - J.D., Yale Law School 1973 (a professional doctorate, but 'doctorate' in this instrument normally means a research doctorate, so postgraduate is the conservative read). B.S. Foreign Service, Georgetown 1968. A15='brief': he went to University College, Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar 1968-70 and left WITHOUT completing the degree, moving straight to Yale - a course of study abandoned, but with no gap year and no derailment.

WORK AND MONEY. A16 - salaried public (law professor at the public University of Arkansas 1973-76; Arkansas Attorney General 1977-79; Governor 1979-81 and 1983-92; President 1993-2001), salaried private (honorary chancellor of Laureate Education, reportedly $17.6m 2010-2015; Teneo advisory role), and own business (paid speaking, reported $100m+ over a decade at $150k-$750k per engagement, plus book royalties on a record $15m advance for 'My Life'). A17='both_equal' is a genuine judgement call and could defensibly be 'under_authority': his identity and achievements are in elected public office, but as Governor and President he WAS the authority rather than under one, and his fortune came entirely from self-employment after 2001. A18 - law (Yale J.D., law professor, Attorney General), teaching (University of Arkansas law faculty), writing_media (multiple #1 bestselling memoirs and co-written novels, Grammy-winning spoken-word recordings), counselling (advisory work, UN Special Envoy to Haiti 2009, Teneo), religious (lifelong active Southern Baptist; Clinton Foundation and Clinton Bush Haiti Fund charitable work), design_art (a serious tenor saxophonist who weighed a music career). A21='net_loss': the investment in his own name, Whitewater Development Corporation, lost the Clintons a reported $37,000-$69,000 and generated years of investigation. Caveat, noted rather than averaged - Hillary's 1978-79 cattle-futures trading turned about $1,000 into roughly $100,000, so at household level the dollar balance may be positive; at Bill's own level and in consequences it was clearly a loss. A22='none' - I searched and found no documented inheritance or windfall; his father died young with little estate. A23='serious_past' is firmly documented: roughly $16m of legal-fee debt on leaving office in Jan 2001, later fully cleared.

MARRIAGE AND CHILDREN. Married Hillary Rodham 11 Oct 1975 in Fayetteville, Arkansas; still married as of 2026, so A24='married' and A27='mixed' (survived Gennifer Flowers, the Paula Jones suit settled for $850,000 in Nov 1998, and the Lewinsky affair and impeachment, and endured 50 years). A26='on_time' is low-confidence: 29 was unremarkable for an American professional man in 1975, though his mother first married at 20. A28='one' - Chelsea Clinton, b. 27 Feb 1980; the Danney Williams paternity claim is unproven and denied. A29='yes' - Hillary has described real difficulty conceiving and a planned fertility-specialist consultation in 1979 before Chelsea was conceived.

TEMPERAMENT. A30 from biographers rather than my impression: Maraniss's portrait is 'a welter of coexisting contradictions - considerate and calculating, easygoing and ambitious, mediator and predator', intelligent, empathetic and indefatigable but also 'petulant, tantrum-prone'. Hence sociable (compulsively so), quick_tempered (the documented private rages), bold, philosophical (the policy-wonk, big-picture cast of mind). I deliberately did NOT pick 'outspoken' - his defining verbal habit is qualification and triangulation - nor 'reserved', whose plain sense contradicts his gregariousness even though he is famously compartmentalised. A31='brief': no diagnosis of depression or anxiety is documented anywhere. What IS documented is the weekly pastoral counselling team of J. Philip Wogaman, Gordon MacDonald and Tony Campolo from Sep 1998, and Clinton's own account of a period of marital counselling after the scandal. That is treatment-adjacent, not psychiatric, so 'brief' rather than 'extended'. A32='strong' not 'central' - a lifelong practising Southern Baptist and scripture-quoter, but politics, not religion, is the organising centre of the life.

PLACE AND CONFINEMENT. A33='abroad' - two years at Oxford 1968-70, plus a whole adult life lived away from Hope, Arkansas. A34='extended' is a stretch of the option and I flag it: he has never been incarcerated or institutionalised; the answer covers four years of Georgetown dormitory living plus Oxford college residence, plus multiple hospital stays.

A36='worse'. Comparing mid-2023-2026 with mid-2017-mid-2023: the recent window brings the Dec 2024 influenza hospitalisation and visible frailty at 79-80, and a sharp reputational downturn - the Aug 2025 House Oversight deposition subpoena over Jeffrey Epstein, a threatened contempt vote after the Clintons rebuffed it, and the Feb 2026 Justice Department document release with photographs and staff correspondence. Against that the earlier window held the Oct 2021 sepsis, which was the more acute single health event; on balance the later period still reads worse.

PART C reasoning. C1 opt2 (unearned luck a difficulty): everything he has came from work; the two speculative ventures both became scandals. C2 opt1: two elected terms, a departure approval rating near the modern record, Presidential Medal of Freedom 2013, Grammys - honour has come abundantly despite impeachment. C3 opt1 at confidence 5. C4 opt1: every achievement happened away from his birthplace. C5 opt2 with confidence 5 - the marriage is the textbook case of real good and real difficulty simultaneously. C6 opt2: Whitewater land was a financial and legal disaster while his later properties are unproblematic. C7 opt2: the McDougal partnership was ruinous, the Gore partnership hugely productive and then broken. C8 opt1 (real difficulty), confidence 5 - fatherless from birth plus an abusive alcoholic stepfather is as clear as this instrument gets. C9 opt1 at only confidence 3, the most contestable item: devoted mother, close daughter, enduring marriage, set against a violent stepfather household and a brother's imprisonment. C10 opt2: $16m in debt in 2001 to a nine-figure fortune. C12 opt2: no inheritance of any kind is documented.
